stories.title: Trump annuncia l'intesa: "Tregua energetica tra Russia e Ucraina, subito in vigore"

en.title: Trump announces agreement: "Energy truce between Russia and Ukraine, effective immediately"
en.summary: Trump announced an energy truce between Russia and Ukraine, but Ukrainian officials stated they have no confirmation of such an agreement. President Zelensky said the announcement was new to him and requested details on when it would begin.

stories.title: Nuovo attacco colpisce l'aeroporto di Riad, incendio a terminal

en.title: New attack hits Riyadh airport, terminal fire
en.summary: Riyadh airport's terminal was struck by an unknown projectile, causing a fire. A cruise missile targeting the airport was reportedly intercepted.

stories.title: Reggio Children, bufera sulla richiesta agli educatori ebrei. Meghnagi: “Metodi da Terzo Reich”

en.title: Reggio Children uproar over request to Jewish educators. Meghnagi: "Methods from the Third Reich"
en.summary: The president of Milan's Jewish community accused the Reggio Children organization of discrimination after it requested Jewish teachers to sign a statement disassociating themselves from Israeli government actions.

stories.title: L'annuncio a sorpresa del Papa: "Mi opero nei prossimi giorni per un nodulo al polmone"

en.title: Pope announces surprise: "I will undergo surgery in coming days for a lung nodule"
en.summary: The Pope revealed he will have surgery for a lung nodule detected in its early stage. He will be hospitalized for seven days starting Tuesday, with scheduled commitments confirmed.

stories.title: Missile Houthi sull'aeroporto di Riad, 12 morti e centinaia di feriti. Trump: attacchi intollerabili

en.title: Houthi Missile Strikes Riyadh Airport, 12 Dead and Hundreds Wounded. Trump: Attacks Intolerable
en.summary: Houthi militants launched a missile attack on Riyadh's airport, resulting in casualties and injuries. The Iran-aligned rebel group continues to threaten the Saudi capital despite clashes with Yemeni forces.

stories.title: Il nodulo, il viaggio e quelle nomine dei vertici vaticani: cosa c’è dietro l’annuncio del Papa

en.title: The Nodule, the Journey and Those Vatican Leadership Appointments: What's Behind the Pope's Announcement
en.summary: The Pope announced health developments using a conversational tone and confirmed his planned trip to South America beginning November 6. Vatican leadership appointments were made in connection with the announcement.

stories.title: «Ho un nodulo al polmone», l'annuncio di Papa Leone XIV durante l'Angelus gela Piazza San Pietro

en.title: "I Have a Lung Nodule," Pope Leo XIV's Announcement During Angelus Stuns St. Peter's Square
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV announced during the Angelus that he has a lung nodule and will undergo surgery in the coming days. The Pontiff stated the nodule was detected in an early and well-localized phase.

stories.title: Leone XIV: “Ho un nodulo al polmone, mi opereranno nei prossimi giorni”

en.title: Leo XIV: "I Have a Lung Nodule, I Will Be Operated On in the Coming Days"
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV announced a lung nodule detected in an early and well-localized stage during the Angelus. Hospitalization at Gemelli is scheduled for early next week, and his November trip to Peru is confirmed.

stories.title: Riad, l'attacco degli Houthi devasta l’aeroporto: passeggeri in fuga tra fumo e detriti

en.title: Riyadh, Houthi attack devastates airport: passengers flee amid smoke and debris
en.summary: A missile strike on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh resulted in 12 deaths and 309 injuries. The Saudi-led coalition attributed the attack to Yemen's Houthis, though they have not formally claimed responsibility. The airport suspended operations following the incident.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia, news. Trump annuncia stop ai raid su infrastrutture energetiche tra Mosca e Kiev. Zelensky: “Se Putin approva tregua di 60 giorni io convoco elezioni”

en.title: Ukraine-Russia war news: Trump announces halt to raids on energy infrastructure between Moscow and Kyiv. Zelensky: "If Putin approves 60-day ceasefire, I will call elections"
en.summary: Trump announced a potential cessation of strikes on energy infrastructure between Russia and Ukraine. Ukrainian President Zelensky said he would call elections if Putin agrees to a 60-day truce. Intelligence agencies warned of Russian assassination attempts against EU defense officials.

stories.title: Raid Houthi sull’Arabia Saudita, strage all’aeroporto di Riad: 12 morti

en.title: Houthi raid on Saudi Arabia, massacre at Riyadh airport: 12 dead
en.summary: Yemeni rebel forces launched an attack on King Khalid airport in Riyadh, resulting in casualties and injuries. Over 300 people were wounded in the incident.

stories.title: Yemen, raid saudita sull’aeroporto di Sana’a. La risposta dopo l’attacco Houthi a Riad e i 12 morti

en.title: Yemen, Saudi raid on Sana'a airport. Response following Houthi attack on Riyadh and 12 deaths
en.summary: Saudi forces conducted a raid on Sana'a airport in response to a previous Houthi missile strike on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport that killed 12 people and injured over 300.

stories.title: Liguria, la Regione rafforza gli investimenti sugli Its

en.title: Liguria, the Region strengthens investments in its technical institutes
en.summary: The Liguria region allocated 6.73 million euros to technical institutes and 6.34 million euros to support employment for people with disabilities.

stories.title: La milanese Medisolve rileva l’austriaca Mides

en.title: Milan-based Medisolve acquires Austrian Mides
en.summary: Medisolve, a Milan-based company backed by private equity firm HIG Capital and a European leader in biomedical equipment management and maintenance services, has acquired Mides.

stories.title: Caccia ai talenti dell’AI: quanto costano e quanto rendono alle imprese italiane

en.title: Hunting for AI talent: costs and returns for Italian companies
en.summary: Italian companies specializing in artificial intelligence are willing to pay significantly more for personnel compared to similar companies, seeking young talent with AI expertise.

stories.title: Ex Ilva: «Stop per l’ordine dei giudici e perché siamo senza materie prime»

en.title: Ex Ilva: "Stoppage due to court order and lack of raw materials"
en.summary: The company cited unrealistic conditions imposed by magistrates within 90 days and stated it halted purchasing for production due to anticipated plant closure.

stories.title: Tatuaggi e piercing, imprese più che raddoppiate in 10 anni

en.title: Tattoos and piercings, businesses more than doubled in 10 years
en.summary: Tattoo and piercing businesses in Italy increased by 160 percent between 2017 and 2026, with Rome leading in absolute numbers and Bari showing the fastest growth rate.
